mapper.select: SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd=#{code} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.proj_stat_cd AS "status",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate", b.bill_id=(SELECT x.bill_id FROM tb_bl_bill x WHERE x.proj_id=b.proj_id AND x.cncl_yn='N' ORDER BY x.bill_ym DESC,x.bill_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_bl_bill x WHERE x.proj_id=b.proj_id AND x.cncl_yn='N' AND x.bill_ym=to_char(to_date(b.bill_ym,'YYYYMM')+interval '1 month','YYYYMM')) AS "targetExists" FROM tb_bl_bill b JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=b.proj_id WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}
SELECT rcpt_sum_amt AS "receiptAmount",unpaid_amt AS "unpaidAmount" FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE bill_id=#{id}

SELECT b.bill_id AS "id",b.proj_id AS "projectId",p.proj_nm AS "projectName",COALESCE(c.clnt_nm,'–') AS "customerName", p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",b.bill_ord::int AS "order",b.bill_ym AS "month",b.bill_dt AS "billingDate", b.sply_amt AS "supplyAmount",b.vat_rt AS "vatRate",b.vat_amt AS "vatAmount",b.tot_amt AS "totalAmount", b.pay_due_dt AS "dueDate",b.tax_invc_no AS "taxInvoiceNo",b.cncl_yn AS "cancelled",b.cncl_rsn AS "cancelReason", b.cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",b.cncl_dttm AS "cancelledAt" FROM tb_bl_bill b JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=b.proj_id LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}

SELECT rcpt_id::bigint AS "id",bill_id AS "billId",rcpt_dt AS "date",rcpt_amt AS "amount",cncl_yn AS "cancelled", cncl_rsn AS "cancelReason",cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",cncl_dttm AS "cancelledAt" FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY rcpt_dt DESC,rcpt_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bl_rcpt SET cncl_yn='Y',cncl_rsn=#{reason},cncl_user_id=#{actor},cncl_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE bill_id=#{billId} AND rcpt_id=#{receiptId} AND cncl_yn='N'
